crossRefs.note: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.

For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”
Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.
I will say of Yahweh, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”
